newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Keycorp buys Tillsmith for C$11.25 mln.
newsitem.headline: Keycorp buys Tillsmith for C$11.25 mln.

text.p: Keycorp Ltd said on Wednesday that it has agreed to buy Tillsmith Systems Inc from the Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce for C$11.25 million.

Tillsmith designs and makes EFTPOS (electronic funds transfer point of sale) equipment for the Canadian market and would become the focal point for distribution of Keycorp products in North America, Keycorp said.
Keycorp said the acquisition includes an agreement with the Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce group to supply equipment over the next three years to a minimum of C$24 million.

"This relationship which does not involve exclusivity by either party to the other, added to Keycorp's existing supply arrangement with Toronto Dominion Bank and the emerging relationships with other Canadian banks, is expected to put Keycorp in a leading position in the Canadian electronic commerce product market."
Keycorp also said the company would purchase the remaining shares in its subsidiary Frontline Technologies Pty Ltd from Hitachi Data Systems for A$3 million.
It said it had retained investment bank JP Morgan to advise the company about future funding requirements.
